note: Live Oak CAD parcel service (LiveOakCADWebService, owner bis_liveoakcad) exists on ArcGIS Online but returns 'Token Required' for every request, so it is login-gated. The only other public Live Oak layer (Property_Boundary_, BIS/TNRIS lease boundary) is a single feature, not parcels. TNRIS StratMap parcel service (feature.tnris.org stratmap25_land_parcels_48) was unreachable from this session on repeated attempts; Live Oak parcel data otherwise appears only as paid vendor downloads (Dynamo Spatial, TexasCountyGISData, Regrid).
